title: Ticket 1.61.10 — R43 food order surname sort and temporary emergency window
notes: Sorts the food order list by last name and then first name when the full-name column is selected. Adds manager-authorized, auditable late ordering for one specific date and meal, requiring a reason and expiring automatically after a selected 1, 2, 4, 8, or 24 hours. Grants are limited to today or at most seven past days and can be revoked early. Uses the existing food_order_logs table; no schema migration, permanent reopening, cloud dependency, or sample data is added.
